note: Vulnerable code stores xmlNodePtr in txtTab array. The fix changes this to store xmlChar* string copies via xmlStrdup.
Creates a text node from the included text file content and stores the node pointer in txtTab via xmlXIncludeAddTxt.
On cache hit for a previously loaded text URL, retrieves the stored text node pointer from txtTab.
Vulnerable code copies the cached text node pointer. If the Reader has freed this node, this is a use-after-free. Fix uses xmlNewText(ctxt->txtTab[i]) instead.

code: cur->type = XML_XINCLUDE_START; end = xmlNewDocNode(cur->doc, cur->ns, cur->name, NULL); end->type = XML_XINCLUDE_END; xmlAddNextSibling(cur, end);
note: Converts the XInclude element to XML_XINCLUDE_START and adds XML_XINCLUDE_END sibling. The text node from the included file is added as a sibling between them.

code: if ((reader->xinclude) && (reader->node->type == XML_ELEMENT_NODE) && (reader->node->ns != NULL) && (xmlStrEqual(reader->node->ns->href, XINCLUDE_NS))) { xmlXIncludeProcessNode(reader->xincctxt, reader->node); }
note: Reader calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode when encountering an XInclude element, which triggers the text loading and caching.

code: if ((reader->node->type == XML_XINCLUDE_START)) { reader->in_xinclude++; goto get_next_node; } if ((reader->node->type == XML_XINCLUDE_END)) { reader->in_xinclude--; goto get_next_node; }
note: Reader increments in_xinclude when entering XInclude content and decrements when leaving. While in_xinclude > 0, the Reader does not free nodes.

code: if ((reader->preserves == 0) && (reader->in_xinclude == 0) && (reader->entNr == 0) && (reader->node->prev != NULL) && (reader->node->prev->type != XML_DTD_NODE)) { xmlUnlinkNode(tmp); xmlTextReaderFreeNode(reader, tmp); }
note: Reader frees the previous node when moving to the next node, but only when in_xinclude == 0. The text node from the first XInclude is freed when the Reader moves past XML_XINCLUDE_END and in_xinclude returns to 0.

code: if ((cur->children != NULL) && (cur->type != XML_ENTITY_REF_NODE)) { if (cur->children->parent == cur) xmlTextReaderFreeNodeList(reader, cur->children); cur->children = NULL; }
note: Frees the text node and its content. After this, the pointer stored in txtTab becomes dangling.
Second XInclude referencing the same text URL finds the cached entry in txturlTab and calls xmlCopyNode on the freed text node pointer, causing use-after-free.
